claim: *From case to theory.* MAGE began with one deeply observed production system, then was compared with seven independent industrial systems. The originating case shows mechanism and sequence; the industrial cases show variation and alternative ways to realize the same moves.

topology.description: Research-provenance sequence followed by complementary depth/breadth evidence, not validation.

required_terms: DocAble One production system, longitudinal depth
Early MAGE Modeling · Alignment · conversion · capital
Independent industrial accounts Seven independent industrial systems
Comparative reconstruction Recurring moves · variation · limits
MAGE theory Refined account in Chapter 6
Depth · originating case Mechanism and sequence
Breadth · industrial accounts Variation and alternatives
A stronger basis for theory Comparison refines; it does not validate.
